thought.text: Core geodata analysis is working end-to-end (polygon attributes + raster elevations). Let's finish up with the remaining endpoint types and configuration checks:

reasoning_content:
Both spatial operations are working end-to-end:
- `/v2/intersect` using a point → correctly returns "Kreisfreie Stadt Dresden" (Kreis) and "Stadt Dresden" (Gemeinde) — a point at (13.7795, 51.0303) is indeed in Dresden.
- `/v2/valuesAtPoint` for the raster topic `hoehe_r` → returns elevation values (115.68 m, DHHN2016) from DGM and DOM rasters. This proves that PostGIS raster extension and raster data are working.

Let's do one more check: the transformation endpoint (a basic one that doesn't require DB), and maybe check the within/nearestNeighbour endpoints too, to make the validation more thorough. Also, we'll confirm that .env.dev matches the DB configuration and that the app is actually using it. Furthermore, we might verify that the dist/ artifacts are compiled. Let's quickly run a within query and a transform query.

tool_call.arguments: {"command": "echo \"=== within ===\"; curl -s -o /dev/null -w \"HTTP:%{http_code} size:%{size_download}\\n\" -X POST http://localhost:3000/v2/within -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" -d '{\"topics\":[\"kreis_f\"],\"inputGeometries\":[{\"type\":\"Feature\",\"geometry\":{\"type\":\"Point\",\"coordinates\":[13.7795,51.0303]},\"properties\":{}}],\"outputFormat\":\"geojson\",\"returnGeometry\":false,\"outSRS\":4326}'; echo \"=== nearestNeighbour ===\"; curl -s -o /dev/null -w \"HTTP:%{http_code} size:%{size_download}\\n\" -X POST http://localhost:3000/v2/nearestNeighbour -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" -d '{\"topics\":[\"gemeinde_f\"],\"inputGeometries\":[{\"type\":\"Feature\",\"geometry\":{\"type\":\"Point\",\"coordinates\":[13.7795,51.0303]},\"properties\":{}}],\"outputFormat\":\"geojson\",\"returnGeometry\":false,\"outSRS\":4326,\"count\":1,\"maxDistanceToNeighbour\":10000}'; echo \"=== transform GeoJSON->EsriJSON ===\"; curl -s -o /dev/null -w \"HTTP:%{http_code} size:%{size_download}\\n\" -X POST http://localhost:3000/v2/transformGeoJSONToEsriJSON -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" -d '{\"input\":[{\"type\":\"Feature\",\"geometry\":{\"type\":\"Point\",\"coordinates\":[13.7795,51.0303]},\"properties\":{\"name\":\"test\"}}],\"epsg\":25833}'", "summary": "Test within, nearestNeighbour, transform endpoints"}
